evidence_cards.content: When reported on the Surveillance NPG by a C² JU, a TQ value as specified in Table 4.4-7 shall be initially assigned to a track not locally acquired but obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC² JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state regarding Track Quality (TQ) assignment for remote tracks received from non-C² units, establishing a post-processing condition for the data.

evidence_cards.content: The C² JU shall extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a mandatory state transformation (position extrapolation) applied to the received data, affecting the accuracy and currency of the track in the system state.

evidence_cards.content: If the C² JU has correlated local sensor data for the track, the requirement to assign TQ based on Table 4.4-7 need not be applied with regard to TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a conditional exception to the standard TQ assignment state, indicating that local correlation overrides the default translation table logic.

evidence_cards.content: Table 4.4-7 defines the translation from Target Position Quality (TPQ) codes (0-3) to Target Quality (TQ) values (6, 8, 9, 10), where TPQ 0 results in 'No Statement' (TQ 6) and TPQ 3 corresponds to '< or = 0.0281 Square Data miles' (TQ 10).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides the concrete mapping rules that determine the final quality state (TQ) of a track based on its positional uncertainty (TPQ).

evidence_cards.content: Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages shall provide nonC² JUs situational awareness and early warning information.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the postcondition outcome: after receiving J3 series messages, the Non-C2 JU possesses situational awareness and early warning information — directly fulfilling the 'System state after successful receipt' requirement for the postconditions slot.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert in their databases upon receipt of the J2.0 message with the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate system state change (database update) required for Non-C2 JUs upon successful reception of situational awareness data containing alert indicators.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving C² JUs shall accept the alert in their databases when a JU initiates an emergency alert on itself by setting the EMG IND in its J2 messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms the postcondition that receiving units must update their internal databases to reflect the received alert status.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message clearing the force tell on any TN in the line or area, all receiving JUs shall terminate the force tell alert on all TNs in a segmented line or multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state change (alert termination) required after successfully receiving a track management command as part of SA data reception.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the emergency or force tell alert initiated by a JU with R² into their databases upon receipt of the appropriate J3 series messages (J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5) with EMG IND or FT IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms the postcondition that the local database is updated to reflect the received alert status for tracks.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall terminate the alert in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message terminating the alert.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the mandatory database update (alert removal) resulting from the successful receipt of an alert termination message.

evidence_cards.content: The Response Indicator field in J3.0, J3.7 and/or J6.0 Amplification messages shall be set to value 1 when a JU responds with these messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific state of the received data (Response Indicator = 1) that allows the Non-C2 JU to process reference point and/or electronic warfare/amplification messages as part of the successful postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: Setting the Response Indicator field to value 1 provides each JU with the option to process reference point and/or electronic warfare/amplification messages that are in response to a J7.1 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the functional system state change enabled by the postcondition: the availability of processed EW/Reference Point data.

evidence_cards.content: After acceptance of a manual correlation the resulting track shall not be the subject of automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific system state change (temporary immunity from auto-decorrelation) that occurs after successful completion of a manual correlation action within the use case context.

evidence_cards.content: If the new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test, the new local track shall be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a postcondition state change (transmission) triggered by failed correlation tests for new local tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A new local track that correlates with another track on each of the first two correlation tests shall be correlated and held as a common local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcondition system state (held as common local track) upon successful dual-test correlation.

evidence_cards.content: Thereafter, the decorrelation rules (see paragraph 4.4.4.3.2) apply to the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the ongoing system state rule application after a track becomes a common local track.

evidence_cards.content: If an operator action has been taken which selectively released a new local track for reporting, it shall be transmitted, regardless of the results of correlation testing.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an override postcondition where operator action forces transmission irrespective of automated test outcomes.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) Identity (ID) difference constituting a conflict; (2) different Mode II codes with local code current; (3) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data; or (4) either track has Strength field set to value greater than 1. Systems shall have an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability to inhibit these automatic restrictions.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines post-receipt system state constraints for C² JUs regarding automatic correlation inhibition based on specific track data conditions, which affects how received situational awareness data is processed and maintained in the system after successful receipt.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.5 (ACT = 0) CLEAR IFF/SIF message transmitted by any JU, the clearing of IFF/SIF data is initiated by operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state change (data clearing) and the condition (operator action) required to complete the clearing function for IFF/SIF data.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF UPDATE REQUEST transmitted by any JU, the data updating process is initiated by operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state change (update initiation) and the condition (operator action) required to process an update request.

evidence_cards.content: For a J7.5 (ACT = 1) DIFFERENCE REPORT, data updating occurs in response to a received J7.5 (ACT = 2) from the R² JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific dependency for the data updating state, linking it to a message from the R² JU.

evidence_cards.content: Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages provide nonC² JUs situational awareness and early warning information.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the post-use-case state where the Non-C2 JU possesses situational awareness and early warning information derived from received J3 data.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs shall process J7.0 messages with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, for locally held remote tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific post-reception processing action (updating local track status) that occurs after receiving management messages, contributing to the system state.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert in their databases.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific database update state for receiving units (including Non-C2 JUs) upon successful receipt of alert data.

evidence_cards.content: The received data, if implemented, must be accepted for retransmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state regarding data acceptance and readiness for retransmission after message reception.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message clearing an alert, all receiving JUs shall clear the alert in their databases.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific database update state for Non-C2 JUs after successfully receiving an alert-clearing message.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J2.0 message with the EMG IND and/or FT IND set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative system state transition where the alert is cleared from the database based on indicator values in a J2 message.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving C² JUs shall accept the emergency alert in their databases upon receipt of a J2 message with the EMG IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: While primarily for C² JUs, it establishes the general rule that receipt of SA data (J2 messages) results in acceptance of alerts into the local database, which applies to the broader context of receiving SA data.
